results.label: Tablet regression (candidate4)
checks: Actual Manager player selection automatically opens that player's position map; Whole team clears core annotations and either another or the same player returns to their own map. Zero recorded position text is grey, positive time remains emphasized, and authoritative primary/secondary preferences receive red solid/dotted outlines with text alternatives.

Actual dual-role context switching, narrow-screen fallback, refresh and sign-out/relogin preserve the device-local preference; unsaved administrator sibling fields survive rotation/toggles without a configuration POST; player and spectator ignore the retained staff preference.

Manager profile text, selected lineup place/complete draft, pending kickoff confirmation and captured penalty/scorer review survive phone/tablet rotation and preference changes; exact local journal/outbox and HTTP writes remain unchanged during every layout action; a running match remains running with reachable clock controls; accepted match stays unstarted, unscored and revision0 without upload, with back/return navigation reachable.

An original Manager read deliberately held until after exact-token sign-out and a new Player login receives401; the old response cannot attach Manager data or close the new private view, and the new session independently remains200. Only captured pre-sign-out reads for explicitly revoked sessions are classified as expected denials.

All five real account types contribute activity; Club Admin/Manager/Player/Spectator have no entry point or API data; rejected credentials stay unattributed.
Real club/team creation and invitation acceptance prove event-time access scope, multi-team non-additivity and safe exclusion of unattributed failures.
A real UI sign-out and fresh Super Admin sign-in occur between completed phases; session revocation, credential verification and all role checks remain required.
Actual dashboard controls request club/team/range/role/outcome filters, reset incompatible teams, and page real history without duplicates when new events arrive.
An actual minute of expanded-history browsing retains every row with automatic updates explicitly paused; manual first-page refresh resumes the actual one-minute timer.
Phone320/390 and tablet1024 layouts fit without horizontal overflow and the actual trend exposes an accessible text summary.
A controlled503 retains the successful report/receipt, manual and one-minute automatic refresh succeed, hidden views stop polling and foreground return refreshes the current authorised scope.
